Review of record — PM ACCEPT + clause-② contract review PASS, both for [PR #12705](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12705) at head `51bf989`.

**Contract-review chain** (`needs:contract-review` hung on both carriers this stroke, reviewed, cleared same-stroke below): eligibility per the downgrade fuse's machine reading — this seat's `external_metadata.last_served_model` = `claude-fable-5` = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (dispatch-seat self-review path, 2026-08-21 ruling). Contract increment read from the diff itself, not the report:

- `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES` gains `manage_org_presentation` (`scope: 'org'`), granted by no shipped set — `single`-posture deployments unchanged by its existence; the entry's comment forbids `PLATFORM_ADMIN_ONLY_CAPABILITIES` membership. Declared AND enforced in the same PR (no paper capability).
- One shared predicate (`metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`, metadata-core) run by all five `/meta` item write doors on both transports; admits the new key only for `declaresOrgOverride(canonicalType)` AND a non-empty caller-own active org — the same value each door threads into `organizationIdForMetaWrite`, so an admitted write cannot land env-wide or in a foreign org by construction. `_migrate-stored` on both transports stays `manage_metadata`-only. Refusal envelopes unchanged (REST 403 `FORBIDDEN`, dispatcher 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`); the common tier-B sentence byte-identical; #6190 five-type identity pin untouched.
- The one deviation the dev flagged for this review — acceptance on all four REST authoring verbs (save/reset/publish/rollback), not save alone — is judged **in contract**: the verbs are one authoring family over the same org-scoped overlay row, and each door's blast radius is bounded to the caller's own org partition (reset drops only the caller's own overlay, publish promotes only that partition's draft, rollback restores only its history). No widening beyond the ruled direction.

**PM checklist**: draft ✓ base `main` ✓ `Fixes #12702` first line, no other closure keywords ✓ scope = 13 files matching the report, deviations (metadata-core as predicate home, rest as REST-door producer, plugin-security collateral test fix) all declared with landing-point reasoning ✓ changeset present (4 published packages, minor) ✓ rejection pins assert code+status on both transports (spot-checked in the diff) ✓ reverse verification predicted-then-measured with on-disk mutation/restore proof ✓ gate union self-reported 0/25 at `51bf989`, to be superseded by CI job conclusions before enqueue.

**Landing**: waits on full CI green on `51bf989` (Lint & Repo Gates, Type Check · workspace, Test Core shards, Dogfood gates still in progress at review time — a converging draft is the dispatch contract's normal state).
